considerations: Size the space first. A typical build runs $3,300 to $13,000 for a terrace up to 100 sq ft and $13,200 to $52,000 for an estate of about 400 sq ft, before the grill and heaters.
Choose how you cook before you choose the grill: gas for speed, a hybrid like the Kalamazoo for wood, charcoal and gas, or a Wi-Fi pellet grill for long smokes.
Plan heat with the electrician. The Bromic 53-inch electric heater is 4,500 W on 240 V; the Platinum 500 runs on propane and needs no electrician.
Luxury builds with premium grills and stone run to $40,000 and beyond, so budget the island as well as the grill.
Prices change. Every price here names its merchant and the day it was checked; check again before you order.
